question: While working in MS Office software, which of the following commands will you give on a US keyboard layout to undo the previous action?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ctrl + Z**__.

__
 
• **Ctrl + Z shortcut gives the command to undo the previous action.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Shortcuts in MS office:**

 
 

 **Shortcut**
 **Use**
 
 

 Ctrl + B
 to toggle the Bold attribute
 
 

 Ctrl + I
 to toggle the Italic attribute
 
 

 Ctrl + U 
 to toggle the Underline attribute
 
 

 Ctrl + Q 
 to remove paragraph formatting
 
 

 Ctrl + C 
 to copy the selected text to the clipboard
 
 

 Ctrl + Z
 to undo the last action
 
 

 Ctrl + Y 
 to redo the last action
 
 

 Ctrl + X 
 to cut selected text to the clipboard
